content.short: Optimum is a data acceleration network that speeds up how blockchains propagate data.
content.description: Optimum builds a universal data acceleration network for blockchains, using coding techniques to propagate blocks and data faster and more efficiently. It is working with Ethereum validators, reporting tens of billions of dollars of stake connected to its testnet. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Optimum.
content.meta: Optimum is a data acceleration network for faster blockchain propagation, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
